verdict.rationale: Modal's own docs say it can "spawn async batch processing and long-running work in the background," so it does run work in the background. That evidence covers one-off spawned jobs only; nothing documents a recurring schedule, cron, or event triggers that would make automations run on their own over time. missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron or trigger-based execution, an autonomous recurring automation setup flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Spawn async batch processing and long-running work in the background.
